hook: Stuck in the *22-A* land list? Collectors told to clear files
hook_b: Stuck in the *22-A* land list? Collectors told to clear files
tldr: Minister Ponguleti Srinivasa Reddy directed collectors of Hyderabad, Rangareddy, Sangareddy and Medchal-Malkajgiri to dispose of 22-A applications on a war footing.

beats.what: Orders cover registering houses, plots and flats on the 22-A list that have GHMC, HMDA, DTCP or municipal approvals.
beats.why: Many applications on lands in the prohibited properties list (22-A) are pending with district collectors.
beats.care: Owners of such flats or plots can face registration blocks; the minister said genuine owners should not face repeated office visits.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Collectors and registrars are to hold weekly district reviews; unresolved cases go to a committee led by the revenue secretary.

cards.q: Clearing 22-A land files fast: what matters more?

qs: How many 22-A applications are pending in each district?
How will officials tell genuine owners from encroachers?

facts.t: Orders were issued on *GOs 118, 76 and 59*, ULC files and incomplete nala conversions, per TOI.

steps.e: Collector checks revenue and registration records

viz.verdict: Faster files for owners; govt land to stay protected

learn.t: 22-A = the prohibited properties list; lands on it face registration blocks until cleared

watch: The committee's ULC report, due within a week, and the CM's decision on regularisation.

sources.name: Times of India
sources.title: Clear all 22-A land issues on war footing, revenue minister directs collectors

fact: Revenue minister orders Hyderabad-region collectors to clear *all pending 22-A* land applications.
twist: A high-level committee must report on ULC cases *within a week*, before the CM decides on regularisation, per TOI.
